license_context: Source-derived CC BY-SA 3.0 hardware evidence; see ATTRIBUTION.md.
scope: Read-only evaluation of complete Quilter candidates 1.1 and 1.2. No input or authoritative PCB write, refill, repair, routing, placement, upload, commit, or main-checkout access.

baseline_drc.disposition: Reused unchanged source-bound evidence; not rerun.

preservation.method: Deterministic KiCad S-expression inventory keyed by retained UUID, with restricted numeric normalization and rectangular-pad angle modulo 180. Structural identity and connected-copper conclusions are reported separately.

common_to_both_candidates.old_connected_copper: All 30 original segments and 10 vias are exact UUID/geometry/net matches; no original copper was resegmented or removed.

new_copper.diagnostic_minima_static_result: Trace width >=0.1778 mm, conservative foreign clearance >=0.20 mm, and outline gap >=0.508 mm. No new via check required.
Trace width >=0.1778 mm, conservative foreign clearance >=0.20 mm, and outline gap >=0.508 mm. No new via check required.

common_output_changes.project_configuration: Both outputs replace the uploaded empty minimal project with the same 2913-byte project. It explicitly sets 0.1778 mm minimum/default track width, 0.20 mm clearance, 0.600/0.300 mm via, and 0.508 mm copper-edge clearance; these are diagnostic settings, not product-rule approval.
common_output_changes.pours_disposition: These two GND plane definitions and cached fills are new output copper; the baseline had no pours. No refill was run during this evaluation. They are not treated as preserved baseline copper or as accepted plane/return-path engineering.
common_output_changes.B_only_witness_disposition: Both candidates route both controls entirely on B.Cu with no vias. This exercises B routing, unlike a legal F detour, but native legality remains unqualified because output DRC did not complete.

native_evidence.tool: KiCad CLI 10.0.6 installed path used by the source-bound baseline

candidate_timeout_record.already_recorded_result: Python subprocess.run raised TimeoutExpired after 60 seconds for each command. No DRC JSON was created. A project lock appeared for each candidate and was removed after confirming no surviving kicad-named process.
candidate_timeout_record.termination_stage: Indeterminate. The lock proves project-open activity occurred, but there was no preserved progress/error stream and no output JSON from which to identify a later DRC stage.

native_evidence.process_cleanup: Timeout killed each subprocess; no surviving kicad-named process was found. Lock side effects were removed. No retry broadened the deadline.
native_evidence.inherited_findings: The unchanged baseline categories remain known, but their presence in each output cannot be claimed from native output evidence.
native_evidence.new_findings: UNKNOWN because neither native DRC produced output.
native_evidence.configuration_effects: The returned nonempty project changes the rule configuration relative to the uploaded empty project and adds two inner GND planes. Native DRC was invoked with the returned project unchanged.

private_evidence.correction_scope: Two implementation-only fixes in the deterministic parser/connectivity checker; no candidate or source file changed.

existing_baseline_native_execution_evide.scope_note: These are the pre-existing successful reference-fixture logs, not logs from the timed-out candidate runs.

limitations: Static connected-copper and geometry checks are independent evidence, not a substitute for completed native KiCad DRC/connectivity.
Foreign-pad clearance uses a conservative enclosing-circle bound; it found margins above 0.20 mm but does not replace native shape evaluation.

The static foreign-net checks covered each new B.Cu control stroke against retained B.Cu segments, through-via annular disks, conservative B-pad bounds, the eight B guards, and the outline. They did not evaluate the saved In1/In2 GND filled polygons against foreign-net through-via antipads or barrels.
The new In1/In2 GND planes require owner review for plane continuity, return paths, and whether output-added pours are admissible.
Cloud completion or all-checks-pass claims were not used.
No functional, engineering, manufacturing, supplier, or child-use acceptance is claimed.
blocker: Native output DRC for both candidates hit the explicit 60-second termination limit and produced no raw report, so inherited-versus-new native findings and native connectivity cannot be categorized.
